recommendation: Implement comprehensive care coordination and follow-up for hypertension patients
implementation_steps: Coordinate follow-up appointments and monitor care plan adherence
Facilitate communication among all team members
Track patient progress toward blood pressure goals
Address barriers to care such as insurance or transportation issues
Ensure patients are linked to appropriate community and social services
evidence_summary: Care coordination interventions have been shown to improve blood pressure control rates, medication adherence, and reduce cardiovascular events in patients with hypertension across multiple studies.
citation: Implementation Strategies to Improve Blood Pressure Control in the United States
